_meta.purpose: Prompt 12 C.4 (review item C, 2026-09-22): the East conflict report. rules.eastConflicts(ctx, days) walks the given days of ctx.schedule and lists every held slot whose holder the East data makes ineligible - a Khan primary on an East busy day (published) or on a forecast-busy day outside the published coverage, someone else holding a derived Silvis slot of Fierce's East week, Fierce himself held in the other role of his derived week. Locks are reported too (ignoreLocks): a locked row is a fact, the report says it now collides with East. A holder who is the derived surgeon in the derived role is fine and never listed.
_meta.shape: schedule = a bare schedule map (no seed rows merged); eastBusyDays / eastForecast are the synthetic East inputs the test passes to buildContext beside the usual test coverage 2026-11-01..2027-01-31 and Fierce's derived weeks 2026-11-09 (Silvis backup) and 2026-12-07 (Silvis primary); expected = the exact report, sorted by day then role.
